description: Wolves spawn naturally in the Chrono Dawn Forest, whose ground is Temporal Grass, because Temporal Grass is in minecraft:wolves_spawnable_on. Wolves are generated with the chunks (a chunk gets a creature pack with only about a 10% chance, and the wolf spawn rule needs light level 9 or more on the ground), so the scenario force-loads a 240 block square around the located biome edge and counts wolves standing in that biome. It does not cover the Dark Forest: its canopy keeps the ground too dark, so no wolf (or Time Keeper) has been seen there even over a 240 block square. The player enters the dimension at 0 0 first, so the Time Keeper Village (placed near wherever a player first enters) stays away from what this scenario looks at.
steps: execute in minecraft:overworld run forceload add 48 0 63 15
execute in minecraft:overworld run setblock 56 200 8 chronodawn:temporal_grass_block
execute in minecraft:overworld run setblock 56 200 8 minecraft:air
execute in minecraft:overworld run forceload remove 48 0 63 15
execute in chronodawn:chronodawn run spreadplayers 0 0 0 1 false ${player}

steps.command: execute in chronodawn:chronodawn run locate biome chronodawn:chronodawn_forest

steps: execute in chronodawn:chronodawn run spreadplayers ${x} ${z} 0 1 false ${player}
execute in chronodawn:chronodawn as ${player} at @s run forceload add ~-120 ~-120 ~120 ~120

steps.command: execute in chronodawn:chronodawn as ${player} at @s as @e[type=minecraft:wolf,distance=..170] at @s if biome ~ ~ ~ chronodawn:chronodawn_forest

steps: execute in chronodawn:chronodawn as ${player} at @s as @e[type=minecraft:wolf,distance=..170,sort=furthest] at @s if biome ~ ~ ~ chronodawn:chronodawn_forest run tp ${player} ~ ~2 ~-4 0 15

steps.note: A wolf that spawned with the chunks in the Chrono Dawn Forest, about 4 blocks in front of the camera and a little below it (leaves may cover part of the view). It renders as a normal wolf (on 1.21.1 there are no wolf coat variants yet).
